metaTitle: United Arab Emirates eSIM | 5G Data on Du
metaDescription: Get online in the United Arab Emirates with an eSIM on Du 5G, from $0.57/day. Install by scanning a QR code and keep your own number for calls and texts.
intro: This page helps you set up mobile data for your trip to the United Arab Emirates with a travel eSIM. The plan is data-only, so your usual SIM keeps working for calls and texts. You install it by scanning a QR code and switch it on after you arrive. Prices start from $0.57/day across a range of data sizes.
countryContext: The United Arab Emirates is a destination in the Middle East & North Africa region, and you will want mobile data working as soon as you arrive. Instead of tracking down a local shop or paying for roaming, an eSIM prepares your data ahead of time. In the UAE, that data runs on the Du network.
networkNotes: In the United Arab Emirates, the eSIM connects through Du, the local network it is provisioned on. Once the line is active, your phone picks up the available signal automatically, just as a physical SIM would. There is no network to select by hand and no card to insert or swap.
connectionDetails: Pick a fixed bundle of 1, 3, 5, 10, or 20 GB, or an unlimited-daily plan providing 2 GB each day. Validity options span 5 to 30 days, starting from $0.57/day, and some plans accept top-ups. The data is suited to maps, messaging, browsing, and internet calls while you travel.
activationNotes: Install the eSIM over Wi-Fi before you leave by scanning the QR code you receive. Leave the line switched off until you land in the United Arab Emirates, then turn it on. The plan starts on its first connection to a local network, so enable data roaming on the eSIM line.
whyEsim: An eSIM means no hunting for a SIM shop when you arrive in the United Arab Emirates and no unexpected roaming charges from your home network. Your number stays active for calls and texts, your data is ready before departure, and everything is digital, so there is no physical card to handle.

faqs.q: Which network will my eSIM use in the United Arab Emirates, and will my phone work?
faqs.a: The eSIM connects through Du in the United Arab Emirates. It works on eSIM-capable, carrier-unlocked phones, including most iPhone XS and newer, Google Pixel 3 and newer, and Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer. Dial *#06# to see whether your phone shows an EID.

faqs.q: When does my United Arab Emirates plan start?
faqs.a: Most plans begin when the eSIM first connects to a local network in the United Arab Emirates, not when you buy it. You can install on Wi-Fi ahead of time, and the plan starts counting once you land and switch the line on.

faqs.q: Can I keep my own number with the eSIM?
faqs.a: Yes. Because the eSIM is data-only, your regular SIM stays active for calls and texts on your usual number. The eSIM handles only your mobile data in the UAE. Remember to turn on data roaming for the eSIM line so it can connect.

faqs.q: Which data plan should I choose for the United Arab Emirates?
faqs.a: It depends on how you travel. Fixed bundles range from 1 GB to 20 GB over 5 to 30 days, from $0.57/day, while the unlimited-daily plan gives 2 GB per day. For light browsing choose a smaller tier; for heavier use pick a larger bundle or the unlimited-daily option. Some plans allow top-ups.
